fields.title: 📖 Keystone: Kufr dūna Kufr remains a Salaf explanation
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn ʿAbbās and Ṭāwūs:**

> ***“The Salaf did not explain the Kufr in 5:44 wholesale as leaving the religion; they distinguished between Kufr Akbar and Kufr dūna Kufr.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** With this the method is clear: we hold fast the gravity of the Āyah, but we judge by Tafṣīl, not by Ghulūw.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr und al-Qurṭubī, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:44.
